title: A dashboard restart orphaned a live 2 h 40 m training job and freed the scheduler to submit it again
symptom: In-process _STATE was lost on restart; the ledger still showed the step running but the scheduler no longer knew about it.
root_cause: Scheduler state lived only in process memory while the durable truth was on the ledger.
correction_made: _recover_inflight() re-adopts any step still marked running with its real job id at mount; verified in the service log for job 44278259.
